_meta._comment_version: 6.6.2 — NONE MODE PERFECTION. VLM 3-way selfie comparison (None vs Standard vs Stock) revealed None is flat/cool/soft vs Standard which adds warmth+contrast+skin sat+sharpening. v6.6.1 warmth 1.12 insufficient. v6.6.2: aggressive warmth +18%, contrast S-curve, skin red/orange sat boost, more sharpening, AE consistency fix.
_meta.name: Xiaomi 15T Leica Perfect — v6.6.2 None Mode Perfection
_meta.description: v6.6.0 hardware-aware + v6.6.1 daylight fix + v6.6.2 None mode perfection (warmth+contrast+skin+sharp)
_meta.v661_daylight_fix: Round 10 tuning: VLM pair comparison (Photon vs stock) revealed 5 critical daylight defects: (1) cool cyan-blue cast (warmth 1.05 insufficient), (2) blown highlights (ae_protection.threshold 0.5 too high, ev_comp +0.15 overexposes), (3) watercolor effect (luma NR 0.985 too high, detail_preserve 0.85 too low), (4) soft detail (sharpening edge_mask 4.5 too restrictive), (5) P-80 vignette bug (darkened corners + magenta tint). Fix: 18 params across 7 sections. P-80 strength 0.5→0.0 (disabled). warmth 1.05→1.12 (+7% to kill cyan). tint_shift -28→-20 (less magenta — cast is cyan/blue not green). luma NR 0.985→0.94 (less watercolor). detail_preserve 0.85→0.93 (more texture). sharpening amount 0.040→0.030 + edge_mask 4.5→3.0 (more uniform, less halos). ae_protection.threshold 0.5→0.2 (save clouds). per_lens.main.ev_comp 0.15→0.0 (no overexposure). per_lens.main.gamma_shoulder 0.35→0.45 (more highlight compression). per_lens.main.saturation_red 0.93→1.05 + saturation_blue 1.0→0.88 (counter cyan cast).
_meta.v662_none_perfect: Round 11 tuning: VLM 3-way selfie comparison (None vs Standard vs Stock) + bridge 2-none AE hunting analysis. Standard profile beats None because it adds: (1) warmth +15-25, (2) S-curve contrast, (3) skin orange/red sat +10-20, (4) sharpening +40-60, (5) slight more NR. Bridge photos showed AE/AWB hunting between shots (093705 better than 093720). Fix: warmth 1.12→1.18 (+5%), contrast 1.08→1.15 (+6%, S-curve pop), saturation_red 1.05→1.15 (+10% skin), saturation_green 0.92→1.0, saturation_blue 0.88→0.92, sharpening amount 0.030→0.045 (+50%, match Standard), edge_mask 3.0→3.5, luma NR 0.94→0.95 (slight more clean), detail_preserve 0.93→0.90 (-3%, slight smoothing like Standard), ae_protection consistency: histogram_feedback ON, max_ev_comp_steps 12→8 (faster AE lock = less hunting), per_lens.main ev_comp 0.0→-0.05 (slight underexpose = more highlight room), gamma_shoulder 0.45→0.50, gamma_contrast 1.05→1.10.

_comment_capture_modes: v6.4.6 SINGLE MODE — mode_fast REMOVIDO (P-73: user reportou que o 15T nao esquenta tirando fotos, mode_fast so atrapalhava). Agora SO mode_max (15/9/7/11 frames, super-res 2.0x, NLM radius 7, full pipeline). mode_balanced REMOVIDO (v6.4.0). mode_fast REMOVIDO (v6.4.6). JPEG one-click por default; RAW disponivel on-demand via toggle na engrenagem (v6.4.5: force_no_raw=false).

mode_max._comment_v651: v6.5.1 FIX CRÍTICO: force_rawmax false→true. effectiveForceRawmax = multi_frame.force_rawmax AND capture_mode.force_rawmax. Estava false → effective=false → YUV pipeline ao invés de RAW → multi-frame stacking DESLIGADO → ruído single-frame. AGORA: RAWmax ativo = raw fusion pipeline (GlesMgcRawFusion + RawmaxExposurePlanner) roda com 15 frames → √15 ≈ 3.9x menos ruído.
mode_max._comment: MAX QUALITY (UNICO MODO v6.4.6) — 15/9/7/11 frames, super res 2.0x, NLM radius 7, full pipeline. ~1.8s latency. PRA: todas as cenas — diario, tripod, low-light, paisagem, arquitetura, retrato, acao, burst. JPEG Q100 + HEIC Q100 + UltraHDR Q100. JPEG por default; RAW on-demand via toggle (v6.4.5).

sharpening._comment_v65: v6.5 U-02: oversharpening -40% (0.09→0.054), edge_mask_strength aumentado (2.2→3.5) para adaptive gating, radius reduzido (0.9→0.7) para halos menores
sharpening._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: amount 0.054→0.040 (-26%, mata halos brancos). threshold 0.005→0.012 (+140%, sharpening agora só em bordas reais — ignora ruído e gradientes suaves). edge_mask_strength 3.5→4.5 (+29%, gating mais forte). radius 0.7→0.6 (halos menores).
sharpening._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: amount 0.040→0.030 (-25%, mata halos 2-3px em bordas high-contrast vs céu). radius 0.6→0.5 (-17%, halos menores). threshold 0.012→0.015 (+25%, skip ruído residual). edge_mask_strength 4.5→3.0 (-33%, GATING MENOS restritivo — v6.5.3 só sharpening em strong edges = soft + halos. Agora sharpening em medium edges também = detalhe uniforme sem halos). VLM: 'soft/mushy detail' + 'haloing around high-contrast edges'.
sharpening._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION: amount 0.030→0.045 (+50%, VLM: 'Standard applies +40-60 sharpening, None looks soft'). radius 0.5→0.6. edge_mask 3.0→3.5 (compensate higher amount with slightly stricter gating). threshold 0.015→0.012 (sharpen more edges). Net: match Standard sharpness without halos.

noise_reduction._comment_v651: v6.5.1: chrominance 0.96→0.985 (near-max — CCD LUT removido mas CMOS ainda tem chroma noise residual, особенно em sombras). detail_preserve 0.75 mantido (oil-painting fix).
noise_reduction._comment_v65: v6.5 U-01+U-04: chroma NR 0.94→0.96 (mais agressivo em sombras), detail_preserve 0.85→0.75 (elimina oil-painting), adaptive true
noise_reduction._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: chrominance 0.985→0.96 (-2.5%, mata oil-painting areia/nuvens). detail_preserve 0.75→0.85 (+13%, preserva textura). luminance 0.98→0.985 (+0.5%, ligeiro mais NR no céu). Net: menos oil-painting, mesma limpeza.
noise_reduction._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: luminance 0.985→0.94 (-4.5%, MATA WATERCOLOR — v6.5.3 luma NR 98.5% era EXTREMO, smearing textura fino em 'painted' look). detail_preserve 0.85→0.93 (+9%, preserva micro-detail — wood grain, fabric, foliage). chrominance 0.96→0.93 (-3%, menos chroma blur). VLM: 'watercolor artifacts', 'muddy/painted on texture', 'fine details smears of color'.
noise_reduction._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION: luminance 0.94→0.95 (+1%, slight more clean to match Standard). detail_preserve 0.93→0.90 (-3%, slight smoothing like Standard — VLM: 'Standard slightly cleaner, applies touch more NR'). Still way below v6.5.3 watercolor territory (0.985). Net: cleaner than v6.6.1 but preserves texture.

color._comment_v651: v6.5.1: DCP CCD removido (force_dcp_id=null) → CCM nativa do sensor OV50E. Safety-net: warmth 1.0→1.02 (levíssimo quente para contrabalançar residual verde QuadBayer). Leica look mantido via tone_mapping + vibrance.
color._comment_v65: v6.5 U-07: saturation_boost 1.02→1.0 (neutro), vibrance 1.01→1.04 (seletivo para cores de baixa saturação)
color._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: warmth 1.02→1.05 (+3%, Photon estava fria vs Authentic). vibrance 1.04→1.06 (+2%, sutil pop sem virar Vibrante).
color._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: warmth 1.05→1.12 (+7%, MATA CAST COOL/CYAN — v6.5.3 +5% era insuficiente em pleno sol, VLM: 'distinct cyan/blue cast', 'pale grayish skin'). vibrance 1.06→1.10 (+4%, 'colors washed out'). saturation_boost 1.0→1.03 (+3%, global pop). Cyan = blue+green, complement = red/orange = warmth.
color._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION: warmth 1.12→1.18 (+5%, VLM says need +800-1200K more to match Standard profile). vibrance 1.10→1.12. saturation_boost 1.03→1.05. Total warmth from v6.5.3 baseline: 1.05→1.18 = +12% — should kill cyan cast completely and match Leica Standard warmth.

tone_mapping._comment_v65: v6.5 U-03+U-08: shadow_lift 0.05→0.03 (menos ruído nas sombras), highlight_rolloff 0.35→0.30 (preserva mais highlights)
tone_mapping._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: contrast 1.1→1.05 (curva suave cinema, Photon era duro/digital). highlight_rolloff 0.3→0.22 (-27%, preserva nuvens sem blow-out). shadow_lift 0.03→0.05 (+66%, levanta crushed blacks das palmeiras).
tone_mapping._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: highlight_rolloff 0.22→0.18 (-18%, MATA BLOW-OUT CÉU — VLM: 'sky almost completely blown out, pure white, losing all cloud detail'). contrast 1.05→1.08 (+3%, mais pop). shadow_lift 0.05→0.04 (-20%, menos ruído nas sombras já que luma NR reduziu).
tone_mapping._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION: contrast 1.08→1.15 (+6%, S-CURVE POP — VLM: 'Standard applies S-curve, blacks deeper, midtones lifted'). highlight_rolloff 0.18→0.16 (-11%, more highlight protection). shadow_lift 0.04→0.03 (-25%, deeper blacks = more contrast). Net: None mode now has Standard-like contrast pop.

lens_correction._comment_v660: P-80 v6.6.0: Software LSC radial correction — kill residual color vignette (green at edges) that hardware LSC leaves behind. Applied post-demosaic.
lens_correction._comment_v661: v6.6.1 CRITICAL FIX: vignette_correction_strength 0.5→0.0 (DISABLED). P-80 shader formula 'vignette = 1.0 - uStrength * smoothstep(...)' with strength=+0.5 DARKENS corners by 50% (sign bug — should brighten). tintG=-0.05 caused magenta shift at corners. VLM: 'subtle darkening at extreme corners', 'color shift toward magenta/purple in corners (particularly bottom-right)'. Fix: strength=0 skips shader entirely (gate: if strength<=0f return false). Shader formula bug preserved for future fix (negate uStrength OR change formula to 1.0 + uStrength * smoothstep). HAL LSC (shading_mode=2 in per_lens.main) remains active.

multi_frame._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: long_frame_exposure_ev 2.8→3.2 (+14%, mais sombra detail em cenas high-contrast). short_frame_exposure_divisor 2.5→3.0 (+20%, shorter exposure frame = mais highlight detail para HDR fusion). VLM: 'sky completely blown out', 'poor dynamic range'. Goal: stock-like HDR com 15 frames.

processing._comment_v65: v6.5 U-06: default_exposure_ev 0.88→0.5 (menos amplificação de ruído), pgtm_pre_tonemap_exposure_boost_ev 0.8→0.4 (-50% ruído)

awb_clamp._comment_v652: v6.5.2 CRITICAL FIX: awb_clamp DISABLED (was true). U-05 set CONTROL_AWB_MODE=OFF + COLOR_CORRECTION_MODE=TRANSFORM_MATRIX with manually-computed gains (kelvinToRggbGains — generic formula, NOT tuned for OV50E) + transform (buildColorMatrixWhiteBalanceTransform from SENSOR_COLOR_TRANSFORM1/2 — may be wrong/missing on MediaTek Dimensity 8300-Ultra). This bypassed ALL OEM HAL color tuning (green imbalance correction for QuadBayer, LSC, vendor CCM) → universal green cast in PREVIEW + capture. Stock camera uses CONTROL_AWB_MODE=AUTO (HAL does everything). Now we do the same. U-05 code stays in place (gate condition fails when enabled=false) for future debugging.
awb_clamp._comment_v65: v6.5 U-05: AWB CCT clamping importado do M9 CCD. Estabiliza WB no modo padrão.

ae_protection._comment_v65: v6.5 U-06: Highlight/shadow protection no AE para evitar blow-outs e crushed blacks.
ae_protection._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: highlight_clip_threshold_pct 1.0→0.5 (AE protection trigga 2x mais cedo — salva nuvens). shadow_floor_rgb 5→8 (garante detalhe em sombras profundas).
ae_protection._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: highlight_clip_threshold_pct 0.5→0.2 (-60%, AE protection trigga 2.5x MAIS cedo — v6.5.3 0.5% pixels clipped era tarde demais, VLM: 'sky completely blown out'). Agora trigga com 0.2% pixels clipped = salva nuvens em pleno sol.
ae_protection._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION: highlight_clip_threshold 0.2→0.15 (-25%, even earlier cloud protection). max_ev_comp_steps 12→8 (-33%, FASTER AE LOCK — VLM bridge comparison showed AE/AWB hunting between 093705 and 093720, 15s apart, one better than other. Fewer EV steps = more deterministic capture).

dcp._comment_v651: v6.5.1 ROOT CAUSE FIX: force_dcp_id null (was 'builtin_dcp_Leica M8 Camera Standard' — CCD DCP mismatched com OV50E CMOS QuadBayer → green cast). force_baseline_lut_id null (was 'leica_m9' — CCD LUT amplificava chroma noise CMOS). AGORA: DCP nativo do sensor via Camera2 characteristics + AgX tone mapping nativo. Leica look preservado via tone_mapping.film_like_curve + color.vibrance + color.warmth.

advanced._comment_v653: v6.5.3 POLISH: mertens_contrast_weight 1.5→1.2 (-20%, HDR fusion menos agressivo, curva mais suave).
advanced._comment_v661: v6.6.1 DAYLIGHT FIX: mertens_contrast_weight 1.2→1.0 (-17%, menos contrast fusion artifacts). mertens_saturation_weight 1.05→1.10 (+5%, mais saturação no HDR fusion — VLM: 'colors washed out'). mertens_exposure_weight 1.0→1.10 (+10%, prioriza exposure balancing = melhor dynamic range).

main._comment_v662: v6.6.2 NONE PERFECTION (11 params): ev_comp 0.0→-0.05 (slight underexpose = highlight room). gamma_contrast 1.05→1.10 (+5%, S-curve pop). gamma_shoulder 0.45→0.50 (+11%, more highlight compression). gamma_shadow_lift 0.10→0.08 (-20%, deeper blacks). sharpening_multiplier 0.30→0.38 (+27%, match Standard sharp). chroma_nr 1.0→0.95 (-5%, more texture). luma_nr 0.95→1.0 (+5%, cleaner). tint_shift -20→-15 (+25%, less magenta — warmth 1.18 handles cyan now). highlight_compression -0.4→-0.5 (+25%, save clouds). saturation_red 1.05→1.15 (+10%, SKIN TONE — VLM: 'Standard boosts orange/red +10-20'). saturation_green 0.92→1.0 (+9%, natural not muted). saturation_blue 0.88→0.92 (+5%).
